description: This file contains utility functions for image processing, including random scaling, flipping, bounding box corrections, color distortions, and image resizing with padding, tailored for object detection tasks within the ImageAI framework.

methods.name: _rand_scale(scale)
methods.description: Generates a random scale factor between 1 and the specified maximum scale.

methods.name: _constrain(min_v, max_v, value)
methods.description: Constrains a value within a specified minimum and maximum range.

methods.name: random_flip(image, flip)
methods.description: Horizontally flips the input image if flip parameter is 1.

methods.name: correct_bounding_boxes(boxes, new_w, new_h, net_w, net_h, dx, dy, flip, image_w, image_h)
methods.description: Adjusts bounding boxes based on image transformations like scaling, translation, and flipping.

methods.name: random_distort_image(image, hue=18, saturation=1.5, exposure=1.5)
methods.description: Applies random color distortions including hue, saturation, and exposure adjustments.

methods.name: apply_random_scale_and_crop(image, new_w, new_h, net_w, net_h, dx, dy)
methods.description: Resizes the image, applies padding or cropping, and returns the transformed image.

ctags.name: apply_random_scale_and_crop
ctags.pattern: /^def apply_random_scale_and_crop(image, new_w, new_h, net_w, net_h, dx, dy):$/
ctags.signature: (image, new_w, new_h, net_w, net_h, dx, dy)

ctags.name: correct_bounding_boxes
ctags.pattern: /^def correct_bounding_boxes(boxes, new_w, new_h, net_w, net_h, dx, dy, flip, image_w, image_h):$/
ctags.signature: (boxes, new_w, new_h, net_w, net_h, dx, dy, flip, image_w, image_h)
